title: REU Research Mentor at AI3
html: Mentored AI4Science research projects at Stony Brook University, from project definition and experiments to reproducible implementation and presentation.

title: Generative backmapping published in CPC
html: Multistep Generative Backmapping of Coarse-Grained Structures appeared in volume 327 of Computer Physics Communications.

title: IAGA accepted to ICLR 2026
html: Our work on identity-aware Gaussian approximation for 3D molecular generation was accepted to ICLR.

title: Instructor for AMS 361
html: Designed and delivered lectures and assessments at Stony Brook University.

title: Three papers at NYSDS 2025
html: One oral and two poster papers appeared in SIAM Proceedings, covering physics-informed neural networks, Hamiltonian learning, and active learning for neural operators.

title: RL-QESA at AI for Math @ ICML
html: Reinforcement-Learning Quasi-Equilibrium Simulated Annealing was presented as a poster.

title: APOD at the ICML Assessing World Models Workshop
html: Adaptive PDE-Observation Diffusion for Physics-Constrained Sampling was accepted and presented.

title: Dynamic Schwartz-Fourier Neural Operator in TMLR
html: Our work on enhanced neural-operator expressivity was published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research.

title: KAR for symplectic learning at IJCNN
html: Kolmogorov–Arnold Representation for Symplectic Learning was accepted; I served as co-first author and project lead.

title: Coordinate Transform FNO in TMLR
html: Our work on symmetries in physical modeling was published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research.
